findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: track_order, list_my_orders, report_issue, get_receipt, subscribe_order_updates · Private data: book_residential_pickup, enroll_in_club, get_service_info, get_my_account, subscribe_order_updates · Public sink: book_residential_pickup, track_order, cancel_order, enroll_in_club, reschedule_order, list_my_orders, apply_promo_code, buy_semester_pass, get_referral_code, report_issue, get_receipt, subscribe_order_updates · Destructive: book_hotel_pickup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: track_order, list_my_orders, report_issue, get_receipt, subscribe_order_updates · Private data: book_residential_pickup, enroll_in_club, get_service_info, get_my_account, subscribe_order_updates · Public sink: book_residential_pickup, track_order, cancel_order, enroll_in_club, reschedule_order, list_my_orders, apply_promo_code, buy_semester_pass, get_referral_code, report_issue, get_receipt, subscribe_order_updates · Destructive: book_hotel_pickup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
